PLANNING YOUR ENQUIRY

Useful details.
A clearer next step.

Start with the information that helps us understand your requirements.

Which harvest services does CPS provide?

Our agricultural services include fruit picking, sorting, grading, packing and loading. Tell us the fruit type and the work required.

What details are needed for a harvest-team enquiry?

Include the farm location, fruit type, approximate harvest scale, services needed and preferred dates. Our team can then discuss the scope and team requirements.

Where can I see the team at work?

The Agriculture gallery contains original photographs of harvest teams, citrus orchards, fruit handling and transport.
